FINANCIAL EDUCATION · Education edition

Housing costs in a household budget

Housing costs include rent or loan repayments, council or property charges and maintenance.

For many households they are the largest single item in the budget.

Hypothetical example: on a monthly income of $5,000, rent of $1,500 takes 30% of income ($1,500 divided by $5,000).

Working out each major cost as a share of income makes it easier to compare months and years. A share is a measure, not a rule.

Learn. Understand. Stay Informed.
